description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Daigala, Dehiovita D/S Division, Kegalle District (241440047)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters, specifically the declaration of title determinations for multiple land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. The content focuses on land ownership, property rights, and land registration processes, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4). It does not involve government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories.
